ambient_events: Muffled bass thuds down through the ceiling from the bar above.
The scarf over the lamp smells faintly of scorching.
A chair creaks under someone who isn't there anymore.
description: A curtained booth down a short flight of steps, where the deals that keep the Dead Pigeon solvent actually happen. One table, four chairs, a lamp with a scarf thrown over it for mood or for darkness, depending on your business. The walls are soft with old soundproofing foam, so whatever is said here stays a rumor at most.
name: Back Booth
